title: Computer Networks: Packets, IP Routing, and Reliable TCP
subject: Computer Networks
description: Follow data through network layers and explain how IP forwarding and TCP reliability cooperate without hiding delay, loss, or congestion.
outcomes: Students will explain how network layering and encapsulation separate local link frames, IP packets, and transport data to isolate failure domains.
Students will demonstrate how IP addressing and routing use hop limits and best-effort forwarding to direct packets across heterogeneous networks without guaranteeing delivery.
Students will analyze TCP sequence numbers, acknowledgments, retransmission, and flow control to diagnose and resolve end-to-end request failures.
